name: holographic-chess-king
description: Holographic chess king — two 4K (3840x2160) Remotion compositions rendered with Three.js

scripts.render:v1: remotion render ChessKingV1 "out/Version 1 - Holographic Chess King.mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render ChessKingV2 "out/Version 2 - Holographic Chess King (Orbit Camera).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
